findings.reason: §12's deliverable and done-when synthesise the folded record in a temporary crew home, so the mechanism is well-founded whether or not that particular fold was ever recorded; the unverified clause weakens only the Why narrative, not any node's work.
findings.text: §12's Why asserts "The coordinator recorded the finding as folded into the run's own node", but the cited run's two stored review records (`~/.config/reckon/crew/reviews/reckon/r-20261019T201233968744-a-tier-none-run-owes-no-review.at-1571d941….json` and `.at-8669dc872….json`) carry no `finding_dispositions` key, and the run's live pointer carries no disposition record, so the fold the section's remedy rests on is not evidenced on disk

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `reckon/crew_run_commands.py` (the widen command and `_widen_eligibility`), `reckon/crew/review_dispositions.py` (the `folded` disposition kind and writers), and `reckon/crew/recovery_classification.py` (the promotion-command composer at 774-782) all resolve; the quoted widen docstring is verbatim; the `plan-commits` and `plan-artifacts` metas resolve.
rubric_items.done_when: pass — §12's done-when names a measurable outcome (the new path in the pointer's write paths, the grant naming the disposition) and three declared negative controls: an exempted-not-folded run refused, a folded-but-live-worker run refused, and a mutation dropping the folded-disposition check under which the first case is refused.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §12's logs sit under the run directory and end in `EXIT=`, durable paths, not a node-local temp or a session scratchpad.
rubric_items.naming: pass — §12 introduces no plan label, ticket number or version tag; `folded` is an existing disposition kind and `crew widen` an existing verb.
rubric_items.reasoning: pass — the stated root cause matches the code (`WIDEN_REFUSING_MANIFEST_STATUSES = {"complete","failed"}` in crew_run_commands.py:1067 and the docstring's "a finished run has no scope decision outstanding" are exactly what §12 reports); the mechanism (read the newest review's folded finding, relax the complete-status and phase refusals only for it, keep the live-worker refusal) is capable of producing the done-when; and the caller runs on the real path — the coordinator's `reckon crew widen` against the run pointer, which is the command §12 changes.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §12 carries one deliverable (widen accepts a stopped complete run whose newest review carries a folded finding), and the `--accept-path` mention is context, not a second scope.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §12 carries `data-links=""` and needs no section edge: it edits `crew widen`'s eligibility in place.
